digest.en: Americas leads the board this hour with MapQuest app reaches No 1 on US Apple list after defying Trump’s Lake Ontario order. Middle East & Africa carries the next thread. 22 fresh dispatches in this edition.
digest.hi: इस घंटे बोर्ड पर यूरोप और रूस की अगुवाई है, रूस ने शुरू कर दिया हाइब्रिड वॉर? जर्मनी में पावर प्लांट उड़ाने की साजिश, बम मिलने के बाद यूरोप में मुख्य खबर है। कुल 25 ताज़ा खबरें इस संस्करण में हैं।

articles.title: MapQuest app reaches No 1 on US Apple list after defying Trump’s Lake Ontario order
articles.summary: Navigating app surpasses Google and Apple Maps on top-downloaded US chart after posting ‘we’re not changing it’A pioneering online mapping app that defied Donald Trump by refusing to rename Lake Ontario has become the most in-demand navigation tool in the US.

articles.summary: Ukraine's top sanctions official arrived in Washington on August 31 seeking to keep alive a sweeping Russia sanctions bill that cleared the Senate with overwhelming bipartisan support but now faces a tougher test in the House of Representatives. articles.title: South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash
articles.summary: Cape Town stunt sparks major debate over safety risksAirlink insist flyby conducted according to regulationsA pre-game stunt involving two passenger jets flying dramatically low over a stadium in South Africa drew huge cheers from the estimated crowd of around 56,000 people, but also sparked a major debate over safety risks. South African airline defends dramatic low-level flyby before rugby union clash.

articles.title: Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb
articles.summary: The confirmed death toll from Nepal’s catastrophic floods has surged to 903, with more than 4,200 still missing as rescue crews and humanitarian workers battle blocked highways to reach the hardest-hit areas, UN Spokesperson Stéphane Dujarric said on Monday. Nepal flooding deaths surpass 900 as needs climb.

articles.title: Morocco not to blame for Ceuta border breach, says Spanish PM
articles.summary: Pedro Sánchez says two countries are cooperating after mass incursion by 70,000 people into north African enclave Spain’s prime minister, Pedro Sánchez, has insisted there was no evidence to suggest the Moroccan government was behind last month’s massive border crossing into Ceuta. As many as 141 people are thought to have died trying to enter the Spanish enclave at the end of July.

articles.title: ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda
articles.summary: On the shores of Nkondo, in Uganda’s Kikuube district, the day begins before sunrise. Fishers enter the lake to fish, while families around Lake Albert rely on its waters for food, income and daily survival. ‘The lake is our life’: Protecting a shared lifeline in Uganda.

articles.title: Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid
articles.summary: Police hunt two suspects after historic 200-carat piece is snatched from Austrian museum during opening hoursAustrian police are hunting two men alleged to have stolen a 200-carat platinum necklace encrusted with 673 diamonds that was on loan to a museum in Vienna and once belonged to Egyptian royalty. Egyptian queen’s 673-diamond necklace stolen in Vienna smash-and-grab raid.

articles.title: Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire
articles.summary: A July roadmap sponsored by the Board of Peace has failed to overcome obstacles that have mired Gaza’s ceasefire deal ten months on. A mix of sustained pressure and diplomatic guarantees is needed to break the logjam and centre Palestinian agency in the strip's recovery. Hollow Promises: Resetting Gaza’s Ceasefire.

articles.title: Curbing Reprisals in Syria
articles.summary: Fuelled by wartime grievances, mob attacks and other forms of retribution threaten Syria’s transition. Damascus has done too little to deter such acts. It should ensure visible legal consequences for violence and broaden locally rooted policing to rebuild trust among vulnerable communities. Curbing Reprisals in Syria.

articles.title: On Our Radar
articles.summary: scans conflicts and crises around the globe every week and features some of the hotspots Crisis Group’s analysts are closely watching. Whether an under-reported trend or a headline-grabbing development, our field experts explain why it matters or what should be done. On Our Radar.

articles.title: Assessing the New U.S. Initiative for Libya
articles.summary: Washington is negotiating an accord that would piece Libya’s divided national institutions back together. But its political aspects have sown fierce controversy. Rather than risk the country’s tenuous peace, U. S. mediators should seek broader buy-in, focusing on budgetary and military issues in the interim. Assessing the New U. Initiative for Libya.

articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट की तरफ से स्टूडेंट प्रोसेस्ट में शामिल छात्रों पर किए गए सभी एफआईआर को रद्द करने और इस मामले का खत्म करने के आदेश के बाद कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) के संस्थापक अभिजीत दीपके ने इस पर अपना पहला रिएक्शन दिया है. अभिजीत दीपके ने सोशल मीडिया प्लेटफॉर्म एक्स पर मंगलवार (1 सितंबर, 2026) को एक पोस्ट शेयर की है, जिसमें वह भारत का संविधान दिखाते हुए नजर आ रहे हैं.

articles.summary: नेपाल में आई भयंकर बाढ़ ने सैकड़ों परिवारों को उजाड़ दिया है। कई लोगों के घर, गांव और रिश्तेदार सब कुछ पानी में बह गए। अब बचे हुए लोग राहत शिविरों में रह रहे हैं। बच्चों के पास पढ़ाई का सामान नहीं है। वहीं, नई माताओं को पौष्टिक खाना तक नहीं मिल पा रहा है। बाढ़ में बह गईं 2 बेटी और पत्नी, शख्स ने रोते हुए कहा- लाशें तक नहीं मिलीं, पूरा परिवार खत्म हो गया।

articles.summary: The Election Commission removed 13.37 crore names from voter lists across 30 states and union territories under its Special Intensive Revision. The campaign began in June 2025 in Bihar and now covers 16 states and 3 union territories after the latest phase. चुनाव आयोग (ECI) के 'स्पेशल इंटेंसिव रिविज़न' (SIR) के तहत देश के 30 राज्यों और केंद्र शासित प्रदेशों में जारी ड्राफ़्ट वोटर लिस्ट से 13 करोड़ (13.37 करोड़) से अधिक नाम हटाए गए हैं.

articles.summary: Bangladesh Supreme Court lawyer and Hindu rights activist Chaitali Chakravarti warned that if current trends persist, the Hindu population could shrink sharply within ten years. articles.title: SC के फैसले पर सौरव दास ने जोड़े हाथ, CJI ने की तारीफ
articles.summary: सुप्रीम कोर्ट ने 20 से जुलाई 25 के बीच हुए स्टूडेंट प्रोटेस्ट से जुड़ी सभी एफआईआर को रद्द करने और इस मामले को बंद करने का आदेश दिया है. कोर्ट ने कहा कि किसी भी राज्य या केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में दर्ज की गई FIR पर आगे कोई जांच या कार्रवाई नहीं की जाएगी। इन सभी केसों को हमेशा के लिए बंद माना जाएगा. इस पर कॉकरोच जनता पार्टी (CJP) के प्रवक्ता सौरव दास ने हाथ जोड़कर जजों को धन्यवाद कहा.
